about: Every practice item and part ID the lesson engine has issued (ADR 046 amendment of 2026-10-30): the engine's block is 900000-989999 in every skill (oetacademy-web ADR-0031 Amendment 1). Each lesson has its own range of the block (`ranges`, set by practice_points.reserve, as the owner assigns them); every ID a lesson uses is issued inside it. Append only: an ID is never reused and never moves to another lesson or point. An ID whose point a lesson no longer has is marked `retired` (the date) and stays in the registry (ADR 046 amendment (2)). Written by practice_points.issue.
